market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from US-Iran escalation, bond selloff, and Fed hike repricing. Oil elevated, equities under pressure, yields at 2008 highs. Expect volatility in energy, rates, and EM. Gold/silver weak on rate bets but geopolitics provides floor. 1-3 months: risk-off with energy and defense as relative outperformers.
market_outlook.long_term: AI/data center capex cycle and defense spending provide structural equity support. However, sovereign debt fragility (France), China manufacturing weakness, and elevated real yields cap multiple expansion. 6-12 months: selective equity performance; fixed income attractive at current yields; commodities supported by supply constraints. Generational shift to alternatives may persist.
